---
name: review-template-pattern
description: Describe reference-matched layouts and repeated feature groups from scan evidence.
---

Use launch/pattern.mjs on one scan and viewport at a time. Name the reference and affected sections. Inspect a counterexample, such as pricing tiers or a catalog where a repeated grid aids comparison. Coach a specific change only when the repetition obscures a visitor decision. Never infer a builder, model, author or copied work from the signal. Link back to the existing DIFF repair instead of adding a second problem.
